release.label: Fracture Active Acquirer Database v1 (2026 Q1)

acquirers.name: Apex Field Services Capital
acquirers.investment_thesis: Platform and add-on acquisitions in field services, outdoor services, and essential infrastructure. Prefers businesses with recurring municipal or government contracts and operator-led management.

acquirers.name: Midcap Ops Partners
acquirers.investment_thesis: Lower-middle-market B2B services businesses with recurring client relationships. Focuses on companies with defensible niches where management depth can be built post-acquisition.
acquirers.notable_platforms: Premier Workforce Group, Allied Business Solutions

acquirers.name: Shore Growth Capital
acquirers.investment_thesis: Healthcare-adjacent services and professional services firms serving regulated industries. Targets companies with strong repeat-visit or retainer-based revenue and limited reimbursement risk.
acquirers.notable_platforms: ClearPath Therapy Partners, Beacon Clinical Group

acquirers.name: NexPhase Technology Partners
acquirers.investment_thesis: Managed IT service providers, cloud-first MSPs, and B2B SaaS-enabled services. Prioritizes MRR/ARR depth, customer retention, and vendor certifications (Microsoft, Cisco, AWS).

acquirers.name: Riverstone Field Services
acquirers.investment_thesis: Essential outdoor and infrastructure services in the Mountain West and Southwest. Targets asset-light field service businesses where crews can be scaled efficiently with strong local market position.
acquirers.notable_platforms: Summit Infrastructure Services, PeakLine Field Operations

acquirers.name: Clearwater Capital Group
acquirers.investment_thesis: Diversified lower-middle-market B2B services platform strategy. Prefers businesses with founder-ready succession, documented processes, and revenue not tied to a single relationship.
acquirers.notable_platforms: Coastal Professional Group, Southeast Business Services Holdings

acquirers.name: Summit Industrial Partners
acquirers.investment_thesis: Specialty trade contractors and essential services businesses in the Great Lakes and Midwest. Focus on essential services with recurring maintenance revenue, local labor market advantage, and owner-ready succession.
acquirers.notable_platforms: Precision Mechanical Group, Lakeside Specialty Trade

acquirers.name: Aerie Growth Partners
acquirers.investment_thesis: Workforce solutions, PEO, and HR outsourcing businesses serving mid-market employers. Preference for businesses with long-standing client relationships and strong unit economics per placed worker.
acquirers.notable_platforms: Prestige Workforce Solutions, Keystone HR Partners

acquirers.name: NexGen Field Solutions
acquirers.investment_thesis: Regional roll-up strategy acquiring traffic control and field services companies in the Western US. Acquires operating teams intact; provides back-office, fleet, and equipment scale to acquired platforms.

acquirers.name: Verdant Facility Services
acquirers.investment_thesis: Southeastern US facility services and home services consolidator. Seeking add-on acquisitions with local brand recognition, trained technician workforce, and high recurring service revenue per household.

acquirers.name: Ascend Professional Group
acquirers.investment_thesis: National professional services firm acquiring accounting, advisory, consulting, and financial planning practices. Offers full practice integration with shared back office, technology stack, and referral network.

acquirers.name: TechForce Managed Solutions
acquirers.investment_thesis: MSP roll-up strategy targeting IT service providers with mature RMM/PSA stacks and existing multi-year contracts. Prioritizes businesses with >70% recurring revenue and minimal customer concentration.

acquirers.name: HealthStream Alliance
acquirers.investment_thesis: Healthcare services consolidator focused on outpatient therapy, occupational health, and medical staffing businesses. Targets non-hospital-owned practices with fee-for-service revenue and strong patient retention.

acquirers.name: Cornerstone Contracting Group
acquirers.investment_thesis: Specialty trade and contracting services acquirer with operations in 12 states. Targets licensed trade businesses (electrical, HVAC, plumbing, fire suppression) with trained workforce and commercial contract base.

acquirers.name: Precision Workforce Partners
acquirers.investment_thesis: National staffing and workforce solutions acquirer targeting specialized industrial, technical, and professional placement firms. Seeks businesses with strong employer relationships, compliance infrastructure, and proven recruiter bench.

acquirers.name: Broadleaf Family Office
acquirers.investment_thesis: Family office seeking cash-flowing essential services businesses for long-duration hold. Willing to buy without a transition timeline if management is in place. No integration with existing portfolio required.

acquirers.name: Cedarbrook Search Partners
acquirers.investment_thesis: Entrepreneurship-through-acquisition (ETA) searcher seeking first acquisition in B2B services. Backed by institutional search fund LPs. Prefers businesses with recurring revenue, owner-managed succession, and SBA-financeable deal structure.

acquirers.name: Granite Cove Capital
acquirers.investment_thesis: Independent sponsor acquiring B2B services businesses with founder-owner succession. Focuses on companies with strong market position and defensible local brand. Raises committed equity on a deal-by-deal basis with high-net-worth co-investors.

acquirers.name: Pathfinder Holdings
acquirers.investment_thesis: Operator-focused acquisition of residential and commercial services businesses in Mountain West. Buyer operates in the business post-acquisition. Prefers transitions where owner-seller remains for 6–18 months as advisor.

acquirers.name: Cascade Long Duration
acquirers.investment_thesis: Pacific Northwest family office targeting high-quality cash flow businesses for perpetual hold. Prefers businesses with strong recurring revenue, skilled management that stays, and defensible customer relationships. No exit timeline or integration pressure.
